title: DEMO RUN OVER SHOWS THE BOARD FIRST
why: His order of 2026-10-13: if you end a run in demo mode it should show the high score table before the next run starts. The run over card was followed by the next run on the very next press, so the board only appeared if you waited the card out. Now the run over card (score count-up, best moments, initials when the run makes the board) is always followed by the high score board with your run on it; a press on the card, or finishing the initials, shows the board, and a press on the board starts the next run. A short hold keeps a mashed button from skipping it. Waiting changes nothing.
now: A demo run now ends on the high score board before the next run can start.
